	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_5_cost
	province_modifier = {
		prosperity_growth = low_prosperity_tier_5
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_stone
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				build_gold_cost = mortar_workshop_build_cost_per_stone_need
				district_build_gold_cost = mortar_workshop_build_cost_per_stone_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	ai_value = {

		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_resource_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}
